title: The Pawn That Forks
setup: Black's bishop and knight stand on c5 and e5, and your pawns are right below them.
hint: A pawn attacks the two squares diagonally in front of it. Which pawn step touches both black pieces?
explanation:
## The Idea

{{d4}} attacks the bishop on c5 and the knight on e5 at once, and the pawn on c3 guards it. {{Bxd4}} {{cxd4}} only hits the knight again, and {{Nf3+}} {{gxf3}} gives the knight up with check. Either way Black loses a piece for a pawn.

The cheapest piece makes the best fork, because whatever it hits is worth more.
